g.text: Sensitivity: covered after the start range
Solid segments: quarters with any covered day (opacity = share of the quarter covered). Light dashed segments: the sensitivity
states' possible start range (earliest to latest quarter), coverage solid after it. Grey band = preliminary SDUD quarter (2026
13 states had Medicaid coverage of Wegovy/Zepbound in 2026 Q1; 5 states' coverage had ended or
Source: warehouse coverage table (state Medicaid documents). Coverage end dates after 2026 Q1 (RI, MA, UT) are future-dated and not shown as ended.
